instructions:
# ReplyNodes App Store Public Reads (MCP)

Read-only App Store API for iOS app metadata and ASO research through the ReplyNodes prepaid-credit fetcher.

## Surface status
-All nine reviewed public read methods are exposed as stable capability identifiers in the manifest: app, list, search, developer, privacy, suggest, similar, reviews, and ratings.
-Each route uses the provider method name and exact option names; app-shaped results are normalized into the public App contract and raw provider records never cross the public gateway.

## How to call
- Resolve the base URL issued to your workspace at onboarding; never assume a host.
- Each tool maps to one HTTP GET capability: substitute path parameters into the endpoint path and pass optional parameters as query strings.
- Authenticate at the gateway with header `Authorization: Bearer YOUR_FETCHER_KEY`; the manifest holds no key material.

## Results
- Success: `{"data": [app records], "meta": {"request_id": "req-...", "contract_version": "v1", "generated_at": "...", "availability": "complete"}}`.
- Failure: `{"error": {"code": "...", "message": "...", "request_id": "req-..."}}`; honor HTTP status and any `Retry-After` header.
- Report `meta.availability`, `meta.missing_fields`, and null counters honestly instead of guessing.

## Conduct
- Read-only: these tools never mutate anything; refuse requests asking them to purchase, review, submit, or touch accounts.
- Respect page bounds (20 default results, max 50); there are no continuation tokens on this surface.
